items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Then we had at one time, Bunk used to come out there and play with us.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, let me see, I had saxophone and clarinet, bass, and drums and trumpet. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Who was the trumpet with your band? Uh, Ollie Drefflin. He was out of Thibodeau, right? Yeah, yeah, from Shrebus, Louisiana. Ollie Drefflin. Then we had at one time, Bunk used to come out there and play with us. Oh, Bunk played with us? Yeah, yeah. And, uh, just all of them.
Where was Bunk living in those days? Do you remember where Bunk was living?
